name: Terran Human
physiology: Bipedal mammalian, adaptable to wide range of environments. Standard oxygen breathers with carbon-based biology.
psychology: Curious, ambitious, fractious. Form complex social hierarchies but prone to internal conflict. Innovative under pressure.
special_ability: Adaptable - Can thrive in any habitable environment

name: Ninevite
physiology: Tall (2.2m avg), slender builds. Pale skin with subtle bioluminescence. Large eyes adapted to bright light. Extended lifespan (200+ years).
psychology: Hierarchical, patient, long-term planners. Value knowledge and tradition. Can appear aloof to outsiders.
special_ability: Light-Adapted - Reduced combat penalties in high-radiation zones

name: Lithoid
physiology: Silicon-based life, crystalline exoskeleton. Slow-moving but incredibly durable. Communicate through subsonic vibrations. No need for atmosphere.
psychology: Methodical, territorial, literal-minded. Think in geological timescales. Suspicious of rapid change.
special_ability: Radiation Immune - No damage from radiation zones

name: Kethrani
physiology: Aquatic origin, amphibious. Scaled skin, gill slits, webbed digits. Can survive in water or standard atmosphere. Chromatic skin displays emotion.
psychology: Gregarious, mercantile, consensus-driven. Natural traders and negotiators. Memory for debts and favors.
special_ability: Trade Affinity - +1 resource when using trade hubs

name: Vesh
physiology: Insectoid, hive-based. Individual drones are semi-autonomous but linked to hive consciousness. Varied castes for different functions.
psychology: Collective, efficient, alien priorities. Communicate through pheromones and gestures. Difficult for individuals to comprehend.
special_ability: Hive Labor - Facilities produce +50% at Vesh populations

name: The Remnant
physiology: Artificial constructs of unknown origin. Humanoid frames with crystalline cores. Self-repairing. No biological needs.
psychology: Cold logic, inscrutable goals. Claim to serve ancient directives. Cooperative but unpredictable.
special_ability: Machine Precision - Repair costs reduced by 1 resource

name: Wanderers
physiology: Baseline human stock but culturally distinct. Born and raised on generation ships. Pale, thin from low-gravity environments.
psychology: Nomadic, pragmatic, clannish. Distrust of planetary populations. Expert shiphandlers and traders.
special_ability: Fleet-Born - Ships built at Wanderer facilities get +1 PD

name: The Absent
physiology: Unknown. No living specimens. Evidence suggests enormous scale, non-carbon biology, possible dimensional or temporal capabilities.
psychology: Unknown. Artifacts suggest vast intellect, incomprehensible motivations. May still exist elsewhere/elsewhen.
special_ability: Unknown - Artifacts may have unpredictable effects
